scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:staging: npm run build -w backend && npm run build:staging -w frontend
scripts.monitor:check: npm --prefix ops/monitor-worker run check && npm --prefix ops/monitor-worker test && npm --prefix ops/monitor-worker run dry-run
scripts.staging:up: npm run staging:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml up --build -d
